correctness.rationale: Fundamental D4 chamber reductions collapse all nonzero normals to 15 support masks; each root height sign is fixed by the mask. Every section vertex is an original zero-height vertex or interior of a strictly crossed root edge. Every section facet is the planar intersection of an octahedral 24-cell facet. The seven inventories arise from a complete 15-mask rational incidence calculation in a standalone checker, with Euler/polygon consistency and additional exact normal tests. All 24 facet sets, 96 edges and zero-height degeneracies are explicit; the uncountable extension follows mathematically from chamber sign invariance, not numeric sampling.

value.rationale: The regular 24-cell is the exceptional 4D convex regular polytope; a complete all-normal combinatorial section classification is a natural geometric invariant. The result identifies exactly six possible vertex counts, a unique generic (32,48,18) inventory, and two distinct 26-vertex types, rather than a contrived finite subcase. It classifies all central section degeneracy strata including symmetric and generic normal directions.
